name: KB · Sessiz lüks
rationale: The owner asked for a corporate page that does not look like every other corporate page. This one says almost nothing: warm off-white paper, one near-black ink at three strengths, a single deep accent that is almost never used, no decoration, no box rules, and a lot of air. The one image is the real 160×44 frame, large and alone. Read, not announced.
notes: Hero and CTA are centred in a 40–44rem measure with 6–9rem of vertical air; section headings alternate left/right (Section `shift`). Type is small and light: display 300, h2 28–36px, body 16px, captions 11px spaced uppercase in text-faint. No cards except the frame bezel and code blocks (surface lift by one wide soft shadow, never an outline). No colour accent word in the headline. Motion: entrances only (0.9s), transcript replays once, frame lens-zoom on hover; mascot holds still and appears exactly twice (statement line, close) — owner insisted it stays. No video, no isobars, no chart marks. rejected: navy+glass (r1), storm-red/Schibsted (r2), light-sky/Fraunces/full-bleed video (r3-4), C canlı motion pass (r5), K2 lacivert band + beyaz gövde/Geist (r6, 'too classic'), R3 hava haritası/IBM Plex/chart-red (r7, 'not corporate'). Owner's tells to avoid: amber, hero for its own sake, unrelated typefaces, too many lines, too angular, everything stacked down the middle (accepted here only for the hero/CTA measure, by the owner's own pick).
